docs.summary: A strategy for migrating instances of some set of types. Asked once per type, not once per instance: the answer is a [`MigrationPlan`](#api~Prowl.Ember.MigrationPlan) that then runs for every instance of that type.
Whether this migrator owns the type. Must be cheap and must not consult [`TypeFacts`](#api~Prowl.Ember.TypeFacts), since the analyzer calls it while computing them.
Builds the plan. Called at most once per type per reload, so it may precompute freely.

Whether claiming a type forces instances of it to be visited even when its storage provably holds nothing migratable. True for anything whose meaning is not carried by its fields, such as a reflection handle, which denotes a type by identity rather than by content.
